parsed.claim: For r = 0 the level-0 rate set (strict constraint s < 2Γ) reduces to {sphericalEntropy u | 0 ≤ u, s < 2·spectralAtom u}. This checks that the degenerate Fin 1 / Fin 0 indexing in Interlacing, Gamma and Phi behaves as expected. It does not prove the open and closed infima agree.

open MetricCodes.Spherical.HigherHierarchy in
theorem probe_level0 (s : ℝ) :
    levelRateSet 0 s = {R | ∃ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u ∧ s < 2 * spectralAtom u ∧ R = MetricCodes.sphericalEntropy u} := by
  ext R
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hI, hG, hR⟩
    refine ⟨a 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hI.1
      simpa using this
    · simpa [Gamma, lagrangeWeight, lagrangeNumerator, lagrangeDenominator] using hG
    · simpa [Phi] using hR
  · rintro ⟨u, h0, hs, hR⟩
    refine ⟨fun _ => u, Fin.elim0, ⟨by simpa using h0, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [Gamma, lagrangeWeight, lagrangeNumerator, lagrangeDenominator] using hs
    · simpa [Phi] using hR
